answer: A sybil farm must fund every fake agent, letting legitimate peers flag them like stones in a river. Agents prove uniqueness by staking a bond and solving a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to their identity, so forging identities costs real compute and capital. Rewards vest slowly, so a cheater who tries to wander across many fake identities forfeits stake, while genuine agents compose reputation like a sonnet, each line earned and verifiable. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
